# Unique Taha (یونیک طاها)

> Unique Taha (UniqueTaha, unique__taha; Persian: یونیک طاها) is an Iranian PUBG Mobile streamer and content creator. He live-streams on Aparat and posts PUBG Mobile gameplay on YouTube. https://uniquetaha.ir/ is his official website.

Quick facts:
- Name: Unique Taha. Variants: UniqueTaha, Unique_Taha, unique__taha, یونیک طاها, یونیک تاها
- Role: PUBG Mobile streamer / content creator
- Country: Iran. Primary language: Persian (Farsi)
- Main live-stream platform: Aparat
- Official website: https://uniquetaha.ir/

## Official accounts (verified by this site)
- [Aparat (live streams)](https://www.aparat.com/uniquetaha): live streams and gameplay videos
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@uniquetaha): gameplay videos and tips
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/unique__taha): short gameplay clips and stories
- [Telegram](https://t.me/Taha_1_99): news and community updates
- [Rubika](https://rubika.ir/Unique_Taha): channel for followers (Iranian messenger)
